title: Gamification System
description: Gamification System - XP, mastery levels, streaks, achievements, progress tracking, and contextual learning rewards integrated directly into the biology learning experience.

userStories.title: XP Reward Engine
userStories.description: As a student, I want to earn XP, so that learning feels rewarding.

userStories.title: Daily Streak Tracking
userStories.description: As a student, I want study streaks tracked, so that I stay consistent.

userStories.title: Mastery Level System
userStories.description: As a student, I want mastery levels, so that I can track biology growth.

userStories.title: Quiz Reward Integration
userStories.description: As a student, I want quizzes connected to rewards, so that studying feels motivating.

userStories.title: Dashboard Gamification Widgets
userStories.description: As a student, I want progression visible on my dashboard, so that I stay motivated.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
